verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first banking platform with Basic-Auth API keys. Its docs show an `account` list endpoint, retrievable monthly statements, and payment objects (ACH, wire) with `status` fields that expose in-flight and returned activity. Card events carry statuses and decline reasons, webhooks provide event subscriptions, and an llms.txt is published for agent consumption. Missing for 10: an explicit unified transaction-history and pending-transaction endpoint, an official MCP server, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
